sections.heading: Treasury condition
sections.body: The treasury totals 1,990,283 USD, all of it idle. The portfolio holds 942,520 USD in USDC and 1,047,762.8 USD in BTC value, with BTC exposure at 53% versus the 70% policy limit. The current outcome preserves runway and keeps liquidity at 100%.

sections.heading: Policy
sections.body: The policy target is to preserve runway and earn on idle capital, while keeping liquidity above 30%, asset exposure within 70%, and vault risk score at or above 80. Live redeemable minimum is 104 USDC, calculated as ceil(100 / 0.995 × 1.03), so a live allocation must stay redeemable above the 100 USDC net minimum after the 0.5% redemption fee with a 3% NAV buffer. Live mode is opt-in only, and the wallet must sign it; it is capped per transaction by the guardrail.

sections.heading: Proposed allocation
sections.body: No allocation is proposed. The Allocation Planner returned 0 legs, total 0 USD, liquidity 100% → 100%, blended yield 0.0% → 0.0%, health 71 → 71, and extra income of about 0 USD per month. There are no approved legs to report, so no concentration share applies and no vault-TVL cap is binding on an allocation.

sections.heading: Deferred (waiting NAV refresh)
sections.body: IX High Yield Bond (USDC) · BNB is temporarily paused — waiting NAV refresh: NAV is 4.2 days old, maxDeposit() is 0 USDC, and the vault is active and open. IX High Yield Bond (USDC) · Avalanche is temporarily paused — waiting NAV refresh: NAV is 13.0 days old, maxDeposit() is 0 USDC, and the vault is active and open. What unblocks both is a fresh NAV update that restores a nonzero deposit limit.

sections.heading: Rejected
sections.body: IX High Yield Bond (USDC) · BNB · Licensed is rejected because the treasury wallet is not whitelisted; maxDeposit() is 0 USDC and NAV is also stale at 9.0 days, but whitelist failure is the hard rejection. IX High Yield Bond (USDC) · Avalanche · Licensed is rejected for the same whitelist failure, with NAV also stale at 13.0 days. BTC Real Yield is rejected because it is announced but no vault is deployed, so there is nothing to allocate into.

sections.heading: Risks
sections.body: The main risks are RWA credit risk, the daily redemption cycle, the 0.5% redemption fee, NAV drift between updates, and smart-contract and counterparty risk. Because the open vaults are paused on stale NAV, the immediate operational risk is not yield loss but waiting for a fresh NAV refresh before any allocation can be reconsidered.

sections.heading: Execution
sections.body: Mode is Simulate by default, so any future eligible allocation would be simulated on the relevant chain mainnet and nothing would be sent. For async legs, requests are processed at the next 17:00 SGT cutoff on Singapore business days, with settlement estimated about one business day later; that estimate is Vaulto policy, not an IXS statement. Live mode is only available if opted in, requires the wallet's signature, and is capped per transaction by the guardrail.
